config.purpose: staged CPU pilot; no universal superiority claim
config.training_budget_note: paired pilot models have identical budgets; saved V2 used 300 physics updates on three grids, so its scores are contextual comparisons only
config.validation_rule: use all nonconstant validation trajectories at each declared grid, component-normalized solution MSE and paired L1; never use test or final holdout for selection
config.phase4_gate: defer head expansion if matched-input pilot does not establish a repeatable numerical gain or conservative safeguard remains costly
config.holdout_rule: specifications generated and hashed before model training; use once after freezing candidates; no hyperparameter changes afterwards
limitations: pilot grid range and optimization budget
Shu-Osher short-time run is stability-only until a converged matched-time reference exists

selection: fixed final update; no checkpoint cherry-picking
training_guard: reject invalid stages/updates, no state repair; not exact original guarded procedure
case_id_definition: eligible N=64 training pool and actually evaluated N=64/128 validation IDs; split-wide disjointness checked separately
